title: Data Understanding
desc: Load the data, attribute types, missing values, duplicates and the class label.

title: Data Preprocessing
desc: Remove duplicates and invalid rows, handle missing values and engineer features.

title: Outlier Analysis
desc: IQR and Z-score on the numeric attributes; evaluate and handle the outliers.

title: Data Warehouse
desc: Star schema in SQLite: ETL, validation and OLAP queries.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
desc: Distributions, cancellation by attribute, seasonality and correlations.

title: Classification: Predicting Hotel Booking Cancellation
desc: Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, k-NN, Logistic Regression and Random Forest.

title: Cluster Analysis: Grouping Similar Bookings
desc: K-Means with the elbow method and silhouette; agglomerative clustering.

title: Numeric Prediction: Predicting the Room Price (ADR)
desc: Simple and multiple linear regression and decision tree regression for ADR.
